warnings.message: npm: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for npm 12.2.1, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (packageManager, devEngines, .tool-versions or a CI setup step) to configure for it

warnings.message: nothing pins one npm for the repository (packageManager, devEngines, Volta or .tool-versions), and npm 11.16.0 to 11.20.0 (with Node.js >=22 in devEngines in package.json) run dependency install scripts that allowScripts does not cover unless strict-allow-scripts is set, so depcurfew apply writes strict-allow-scripts=true; with it, in npm 12.0.0 and later the install fails instead of blocking the script with a warning
warnings.fix: Make every place listed here run npm 12.0.0 or later (npm install -g npm@12.0.0 before it installs packages; npm 12.0.0 runs on Node.js ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0 only; a pin in packageManager or devEngines does not change the npm they run), and depcurfew apply leaves strict-allow-scripts out. Until then, review the packages an install stops at and add them to installScripts.allow or installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json

warnings.message: npm 11.6.0 (the lowest version devEngines in package.json allows) and npm 10.5.1 to 11.13.0 (with Node.js >=22 in devEngines in package.json) run every dependency install script and have no allow-list, so "deny" cannot be enforced there
warnings.fix: Install npm 11.16.0 or later before packages are installed there (npm install -g npm@11.16.0; npm 11.16.0 runs on Node.js ^20.17.0 || >=22.9.0 only), or move to a Node.js release that comes with it; npm 12 blocks dependency scripts by default

warnings.message: npm: allowScripts takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: Renovate: configuration in package.json is deprecated and depcurfew does not edit it
warnings.fix: Move it to renovate.json, or add the snippet by hand
